theorems.name: Submission.dimred_mbl_dtsd_gr_liminf_slice_le_deriv
theorems.statement: ∀ (α : Type) [MeasurableSpace α] (μ : Measure α) (f : α → ℝ) (t : ℝ), IsFiniteMeasure μ → Measurable f → DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun s : ℝ => (μ {x | f x < s}).toReal) t → liminf (fun h : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal h⁻¹ * μ {x | t - h < f x ∧ f x < t}) (𝓝[>] 0) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (deriv (fun s : ℝ => (μ {x | f x < s}).toReal) t)
